tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale (POS) system for a restaurant client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, ensuring reliable transaction handling deployed on Azure.
Developed Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform across three services with JWT authentication, Joi-based validation, and a server-side proxy API deployed via Vercel, Render, and MongoDB Atlas.
Built DriftGuard, a MERN-stack security control drift detection tool mapping real-time configuration changes to NIST and GDPR compliance controls during a hackathon build.
Engineered StaySphere, an Airbnb-style property listing platform using Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and Passport.js authentication with ownership-based authorization.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team, I am writing to apply for the MERN Developer – Intern role at Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies Private Limited in Bangalore. As an MCA student at PES University with a CGPA of 8.48 and hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team. During my internship as a Full Stack Developer at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL that went live for real customer bookings. Additionally, my project work includes developing Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform using the MERN stack featuring JWT authentication and server-side API integration, and StaySphere, a property rental platform built with Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. These experiences have given me strong practical knowledge of JavaScript, Node.js, React.js, and database systems like SQL and MongoDB. I am enthusiastic about the opportunity to bring my full-stack capabilities to Nxtwave and contribute to your internship and full-time conversion goals. Thank you for your time and consideration. Sincerely, Amaanuddin Ahmed
